mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (amphetamine prodrug) may potentiate CNS stimulation and cardiovascular effects while quetiapine's antipsychotic activity may be partially antagonized by amphetamine-induced dopaminergic activity.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy, increased stimulant side effects (tachycardia, hypertension, insomnia), and behavioral changes; consider dose adjustments or alternative stimulant therapy if used together for ADHD.
